subject: EVS

source.name: NCERT — Looking Around EVS teacher note (primary EVS scheme, Classes I–V)

notes: No separate EVS textbook at Class 1. NCERT (NCF 2005) states EVS is a subject only in Classes III–V; in Classes I–II its concerns are part of Language and Mathematics. Prescribed Class-1 books: Mridang (English), Sarangi (Hindi), Joyful Mathematics — EVS themes (surroundings, plants/animals, family, water, cleanliness) woven in thematically.
